agent.problem: This reproduces John 10:41 and asks for its unseen final word. The earlier cards only establish that many people came to Jesus and spoke about John; they provide no basis for reasoning that the people's verdict was “true” rather than “strange” or “forgotten.” The blank therefore tests wording the baker has not seen instead of meaning they can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
